credits: (IGCS per-game pool, raptoravis UUU 5.8.11 catalog: 3 keys)
notes: Avowed has 3 dedicated AOB keys in the UUU 5.8.11 catalog. Per-game AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 uses 'rep movsq' instead of the field-by-field MOV block (Obsidian compiler optimization). We try the per-game pattern first, fall back to the shared SSE variant. Obsidian / Microsoft, no anti-cheat.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_avowed
intercepts.description: Per-game AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1: 'rep movsq' copies 9 qwords (72 bytes) of FMinimalViewInfo from rdx to r15, then writes one DWORD field at [rbx+0x1538].

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_sse_fallback
intercepts.description: Shared UE5 pool fallback (SSE variant) -- only matches if the per-game pattern above misses.

capture._capture_note: UE5 reversed-Z. Open-world fantasy vistas -> log curve.

camera_write_profile._comment: Avowed uses the standard UE5 FMinimalViewInfo layout. Source pointer is rdx at hook entry (the rep-movsq source). Location is FVector3d (3 doubles, 24 bytes), Rotation FRotator (3 floats, 12 bytes), FOV float at 0x24.
